svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 07 / SPACE INVADERS
svg.desc: 14,850 GitHub contributions across 142 active days, 2025-10-19 to 2026-10-18. The ship fires at real contribution dates in ascending count order. Invaders disappear only on projectile impact. A streak of seven consecutive active dates unlocks a boss.
